wb = load_workbook(input_path)
print("Sheets:", wb.sheetnames)
for ws in wb.worksheets:
    print(f"Sheet {ws.title}: max_row={ws.max_row}, max_col={ws.max_column}")
    # Print real non-empty bounds and a small preview of values

    if nonempty:
        print("Non-empty cells:")
        for item in nonempty[:50]:
            print(item)
    else:
        print("No non-empty cells")

ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Step 2: SOLVE
# Remove every character except digits, decimal points, and commas from A1:H1.
# Derive values directly from each input cell in the specified range.
allowed_pattern = re.compile(r"[^0-9.,]")

for row in ws["A1:H1"]:

        if original is None:
            continue
        cleaned = allowed_pattern.sub("", str(original))
        cell.value = cleaned

wb.save(output_path)

            break
